problems: Columns "NUMBER OF BEDROOMS" and "NUMBER OF BATHROOMS" were mapped to beds/baths respectively; the table has no separate "rooms" or "floor" column.
The "RENT REGULATED STATUS" column (V, RS) values are placed in the note field for each unit since they don't fit a defined column; this is not a beds/baths code.
An "APPROX. OUTDOOR SQUARE FOOTAGE" column exists and was mapped to ext_sf; most units are blank (-), some have a single outdoor SF number which was used directly.

This offering plan contains two parallel Schedule A tables for the same units and prices: OPTION A (pages 72-74, transcribed above) and OPTION B (pages 75-77), which differ only in the percentage-of-common-interest, common-charge, and total-carrying-charge columns (real estate taxes are identical in both options). Per the fixed 20-column format only one schedule could be captured; OPTION B was not transcribed. If OPTION B data is needed, it should be requested separately.

Page 74 total row breakdown: "Community Facility" (sf 7143, pct 7.1757%, cc_a 47622.26, cc_m 3968.52, tax_a 102546.00, tax_m 8545.50, carry_a 150168.26, carry_m 12514.02) and "Development Unit" (int_sf 153, ext_sf 2040, pct 0.6660%, cc_a 2710.66, cc_m 225.89, tax_a 9164.00, tax_m 763.67, carry_a 11874.66, carry_m 989.55) rows are non-residential/other categories not included as U lines since they are not individually priced units with the standard unit-row format; only the Residential Total was used for the TOTAL line.
